## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
Rotation: Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Industrials showing broad strength while Technology is mixed (large-cap tech leaders plus clear tech laggards), supporting a ROTATION away from narrow growth leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.04% | 1M: +20.33%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +6.71%). Energy strong: VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +5.58%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), PSX RECOVERY (1W: +6.42% | 1M: -1.06%). Industrials solid: BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +12.99%), CAT RECOVERY (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -1.10%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Staples weak: PG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -3.77%), PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -5.52%), MDLZ BELOW TREND (1W: -5.16% | 1M: -5.33%). Communication under pressure: META BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -3.59%). Real Estate lagging: CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -3.57%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +5.58%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span Technology, Energy, Materials) — cyclical tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -3.77%), PM CORRECTION (1W: -4.20% | 1M: +5.92%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -3.57%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%), PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -5.52%). Weakness concentrated in Consumer Staples and select defensives.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +5.58%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%). Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large names (PM, MSFT, AIG, PSX, CAT) show 1W vs 1M flips — tactical risk, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with rotation signs; AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +3.67%) contrasted with AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%) and META BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -3.59%). Tech breadth: 12/19 positive — internal rotation within the group.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials constructive: GS ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +10.12%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.26%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.44%), offset by AIG CORRECTION (1W: -10.52% | 1M: +0.58%). Financials breadth: 14/20 positive — supports cyclical/value style.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare showing resilience: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +9.68%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +3.95%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.75%), with PFE RECOVERY (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -2.88%). Healthcare breadth: 11/15 positive — defensive support but selective.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value names amid rotation: Financials and Industrials (JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.26%), GS ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +10.12%)), and Materials/Energy (FCX ABOVE TREND, SLB ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to large-cap defensive/consumer staples and lagging tech like AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%) and META BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -3.59%); monitor divergences before adding to core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%) — sentiment confirmed and strong momentum; SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%) — news-driven strength; INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%) — momentum.  
BEARISH: AIG CORRECTION (1W: -10.52% | 1M: +0.58%) — headline-driven drop; PG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -3.77%) — staples weakness; XOM CORRECTION (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +1.67%) — earnings warning risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (breadth: 6/7 positive) and Energy (breadth: 6/8 positive) — cyclicals leading; Industrials (breadth: 9/13 positive) — order/margin news can extend moves.  
BEARISH: Consumer Staples (breadth: 3/11 positive), Communication (breadth: 2/7 positive), Real Estate (breadth: 2/6 positive) — defensive groups under pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for resistance continuation around prior highs (NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +3.67%)); monitor AAPL support around recent lows (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -6.62%)); JPM breakout watch (JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.26%)) and SLB continuation above recent pivot (SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMAT (+55): AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%) — news and price confirming momentum.  
BA (+60): BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.40% | 1M: +12.99%) — order headlines confirmed by rally.  
JNJ (+55): JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.75%) — trial win and price modestly confirming.  
SLB (+50): SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.91% | 1M: +10.17%) — deal news confirmed by strong price action.  
AMZN (+50): AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +5.24%) — upgrade-driven and price confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AIG (-65): AIG CORRECTION (1W: -10.52% | 1M: +0.58%) — CEO departure news confirmed by heavy drop.  
XOM (-55): XOM CORRECTION (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +1.67%) — earnings/headline pressure aligning with weakness.  
PFE (-50): PFE RECOVERY (1W: +1.16% | 1M: -2.88%) — negative legal headline but price showing short-term recovery (divergence to monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Financials, Industrials and Materials lead while Tech is internally rotating. Top relative strength: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +2.95%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +9.03%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +22.79%). Key risk: multiple large-cap divergences and headline-driven drops (AIG, XOM, PG) — monitor sentiment-confirmation mismatches before enlarging positions.
